# TRIPPLE AI SYSTEMS

> TRIPPLE AI SYSTEMS is a premier AI Automation Agency based in Nairobi, Kenya, engineering bespoke sovereign multi-agent architectures, managed automation pipelines, and real-time operational telemetry for enterprise organizations worldwide. Founded by Given Arori Arori.

## Core Services
- **Custom AI Agent Engineering**: Autonomous multi-agent swarms tailored to proprietary enterprise operations. Deterministic fallback checks, self-healing daemons, sub-380ms response loops.
- **Managed Automation Pipelines**: End-to-end resilient data pipelines that synchronize across CRMs, legacy databases, ERPs, and third-party tools 24/7 with zero data loss.
- **Performance Analytics & Operational Audit**: Real-time telemetry dashboards exposing process bottlenecks, calculating ROI, and forecasting resource demands.
- **Enterprise System Integration**: Secure bridges connecting modern foundation LLMs (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI) to on-premise ERPs and relational databases under SOC-2 compliant sandboxes.
- **Cognitive Knowledge Extraction**: Multi-modal visual parsing transforming contracts, PDFs, invoices, and unstructured communications into structured database entities.
- **Autonomous Customer Dispatch**: AI agents resolving high-friction tickets within seconds with human-in-the-loop escalation triggers.

## Key Guarantees
- 100% Client-Owned Intellectual Property (Custom agent weights, pipelines, tools, and code remain the client's sole property).
- Zero-Leak Enterprise Sandboxing (Data in transit TLS 1.3, at rest AES-256; client data is never used to train public foundation models).
- Value-Based Milestone Pricing (Transparent fixed-price deliverables or dedicated engineering retainers with guaranteed ROI).
- Human Augmentation Focus (Automating repetitive drudgery so human talent focuses on high-leverage strategy).
